description: Redesign Home.jsx dashboard to be more user-friendly with a welcoming greeting, clear quick-action cards, an activity timeline, and agent status overview. Replace the current technical admin/VLE split with a unified friendly dashboard that gives CSC operators immediate clarity on what to do next.
steps: Rewrite frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx to include: (1) A greeting section with user name, date/time, and a motivational summary sentence showing key metrics inline. (2) A 'Quick Actions' grid with large clickable cards linking to: New Bulk Import (/bulk-import), Manage Candidates (/candidates), View Documents (/documents), Search Jobs (/jobs) - each with an icon, title, and short description. (3) A compact stats row using the existing StatsCard pattern showing: Active Jobs, Documents Pending, Agents Online, Success Rate. (4) A 'Recent Activity' timeline showing the last 5 jobs with status icons, candidate name, service type, and relative timestamps. (5) An 'Agent Status' compact panel showing agents as small pills/chips with color-coded status dots (green=active, amber=busy, red=error, gray=idle).

Create a new reusable component frontend/src/components/Common/QuickActionCard.jsx that accepts: icon (lucide icon component), title, description, linkTo (route path), and color. It should render as a clickable card with hover effect using react-router-dom Link, with the icon displayed prominently, and use framer-motion whileHover for subtle scale effect.

Create a new reusable component frontend/src/components/Common/ActivityTimeline.jsx that accepts an array of activity items (jobs) and renders them as a vertical timeline with status-colored dots, job type, candidate name, and relative time (e.g., '5 min ago', '2 hours ago'). Include an empty state with a friendly message.

Keep the admin-specific insights (Infrastructure Health, Owner Insights) available only when user.role === 'admin', but present them in a cleaner collapsible section at the bottom rather than replacing the entire dashboard.
Ensure the new Home page works well on mobile (stack cards vertically, reduce padding, use responsive grid classes like grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4).
acceptance_criteria: Home page displays a personalized greeting with the user's name
Quick Action cards are visible and link to the correct routes
Stats row shows real data from the store (activeJobs, pendingDocuments, etc.)
Recent Activity timeline shows the latest jobs from the store
Agent status pills show real agent status data from the store
Page is responsive and usable on mobile viewports (320px+)
Admin-only content is conditionally rendered for admin users
All imports use existing dependencies only (lucide-react, framer-motion, react-router-dom, zustand store)
verification: Read the modified Home.jsx and new component files to verify they follow existing patterns and use only available dependencies
Verify the components import from correct paths and use the existing store hooks
Check that responsive Tailwind classes are used correctly
findings: No node_modules present; cannot run vite build. Verified code correctness by manual review of all imports and syntax. All imports use existing dependencies only. INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode prevents npm install.
